title: dahlia coccinea var. gentryi
intro: Dahlia coccinea var. gentryi, commonly known as a species of flowering plant, is a type of dahlia that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its reported health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in the treatment of various ailments such as wounds and skin conditions. The plant is also believed to possess therapeutic actions, including analgesic and antispasmodic properties, which may help to relieve pain and muscle spasms. Bioactive constituents of Dahlia coccinea var. gentryi include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may have potential applications in the development of new medicines.
